agents.name: Telecom RAG Agent
agents.description: A small retrieval-augmented telecom agent: retrieves context from a TeleQnA knowledge base, then answers a multiple-choice question or refuses when confidence is low. Dependencies (embedder + LLM) are injected, so the definition is reusable and testable with stubs. Maps the refusal guardrail to the UAE AI Charter (human oversight / robustness).
agents.guardrails: Refuses (returns None) when top retrieval similarity < 0.25; logs every tool call for audit.
